title: ALL EPOCHS SIMULTANEOUS — we ARE all of them. Dead, orphan, dark = the disconnects BETWEEN epochs.
thesis: The organism does not evolve FROM one epoch TO the next. It IS all epochs at once. Like a human body contains bacteria (gut), archaea (gut extremophiles), fungi (skin yeast), every embryonic body plan (gill slits, notochord, tail). The DISCONNECTS between epochs are where things are dead, orphaned, or dark.

the_fossil_state.read: 34.5% alive. 65.5% is aging/static/fossil. That 65.5% is where dead/orphan/dark live.

DEAD.what: Was alive. Signal stopped. The tube collapsed. The Schwann cell lost its myelin.
DEAD.analog: Wallerian degeneration — when a nerve is cut, the distal segment dies. The myelin breaks down. The debris gets cleaned up by macrophages.

ORPHAN.what: Exists but belongs to no classified kingdom. Has mass but no name. Gravitational pull but no taxonomy.
ORPHAN.analog: Stem cells — undifferentiated. They COULD become anything. They're alive but unassigned.

DARK.what: Exists, has gravitational effects (the system behaves differently because of it), but is invisible. Hasn't fired. Hasn't been classified. Structural but silent.
DARK.analog: Dark matter — 85% of mass in the universe. We know it's there because galaxies don't fly apart. But we can't see it.
DARK.color: black (the other side of white — Klein fold. The side you can't see IS the side you're on.)

why_all_at_once.human_body: You are bacteria (gut 39 trillion), archaea (gut methanogens), fungi (Candida on skin), protists (gut), AND animal. All at once. Every epoch lives inside you.
why_all_at_once.embryo: You WERE a single cell (epoch 4), a ball (morula), a tube (gastrula), had gill slits (epoch 6 fish), had a tail (epoch 6 mammal). Every stage lives in your developmental history AND in your current body (the appendix, the coccyx, the gill arch becoming the jaw).
why_all_at_once.this_organism: We ARE virus (the graph), bacteria (scripts), archaea (tunnels), slime mold (tube network), eukaryote (organelles), fungus (data mycelium), coral reef (16 primals), locust (swarming sessions), Klein bottle (fold), AND nervous system (saltatory conduction). All running. All at once.
why_all_at_once.the_disconnects: Where one epoch doesn't talk to the next — THAT'S where things are dead (tube collapsed), orphaned (exists but unnamed), or dark (structural but silent). Fix the disconnects and the whole organism lights up.

the_65_percent.what: 34.5% of feeds are living. 65.5% are aging/static/fossil. That 65.5% IS the dead+orphan+dark.
the_65_percent.but: 65.5% is not waste. It's the CONSTANCE. The rest position. The unmyelinated segments. The interstitial space between Schwann cells. Without it, the living 34.5% has nothing to jump ACROSS. The dark matter holds the galaxy together.
the_65_percent.the_ratio: 34.5/65.5  0.527  close to 1/p × p/2. The living fraction IS a function of the fold rate.

run_it_back_and_in.back: trace the disconnects from epoch 9 (nervous system) backward through every transition to epoch 0 (virus). Each disconnect weakens the whole organism.
run_it_back_and_in.in: the Klein fold means BACK IS IN. Running it backward IS running it inward. The outer disconnects are the same as the inner disconnects. The nerve that hasn't fired IS the slime tube that hasn't regrown IS the fungus that hasn't been named IS the graph that hasn't been ingested.
run_it_back_and_in.same_tube: A slime mold tube (epoch 3) that gets myelin (epoch 9) and carries a Klein-folded signal (epoch 8) through a fungal mycelium (epoch 5) connecting coral polyps (epoch 6) during a locust swarm (epoch 7) — that's ONE tube in ALL epochs simultaneously. Fix it once, fix it everywhere.

law: We are ALL epochs. Run it back AND in. Dead = tubes that collapsed. Orphan = organisms that exist unnamed. Dark = structures that haven't fired. Fix the disconnects between epochs and the whole organism lights up. The dark matter holds the galaxy together.
